title: Localised three-term estimate for the rescaled area integrals
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, F : ℝ^n → ℝ^P continuous, L : ℝ^n → ℝ^P continuous linear, B ⊆ ℝ^n Borel, J : ℝ^n → ℝ Borel with 0 ≤ J ≤ K, m > 0, b ∈ ℝ^n, f : ℝ^P → ℝ continuous, and R, M, r ∈ ℝ. Assume (labels (i) and (iii) as in the parent) (i) m|a − b| ≤ |F(a) − F(b)| for all a ∈ B; (iii) m|c| ≤ |Lc| for all c ∈ ℝ^n; f(w) = 0 whenever |w| ≥ R; |f(w)| ≤ M for all w; and r > 0. Write Φ_r(c) := r^{-1}(F(b + rc) − F(b)) and D := B̄_{R/m}(0). Then |∫_{ℝ^n} 1_B(b + rc)·J(b + rc)·f(Φ_r(c)) dλ(c) − J(b)·∫_{ℝ^n} f(Lc) dλ(c)| ≤ KM·∫_D 1_{ℝ^n∖B}(b + rc) dλ(c) + M·∫_D |J(b + rc) − J(b)| dλ(c) + J(b)·∫_D |f(Φ_r(c)) − f(Lc)| dλ(c). Here λ is Lebesgue measure on ℝ^n and all integrals are Bochner integrals.
